patterns: Live-action remake of a game IP exploded: EHuanglu's 'AI made king of fighters in live action' hit 201K views / 1.3K likes / 431 bookmarks, 3x the next post. Formula: beloved franchise + 'in live action', one-line caption, pure visual.

The decade-swap format is a repeatable winner: techhalla's 'Back to the Future but it's 1973' 66K / 1.3K likes / 272 bookmarks, right after his 'Matrix but it's 1981' 56K the day before. Same 6-word caption template.
Short narrative AI films with a tool credit land solidly: azed_ai's 'The Wow Lunch' (Midjourney images animated with Seedance 2) 6K / 32 bookmarks.
Model face-offs keep getting saves but modest reach on a Sunday: AIWarper Flux 3 vs Kling 4 vs Kling 4 Flash 3K / 19 bookmarks; CharaspowerAI Minimax H3 ice + destruction VFX 1.8K / 24 bookmarks.
Off-niche tech news still reaches: minchoi on Tesla FSD v15 9.9K.
